papers.title: The Relationship between Fatigue Life and the Microstructure and Mesostructure of Additively Manufactured Materials
papers.abstract: Topology optimization and novel manufacturing technologies like additive manufacturing (AM) have provided designers with the tools to manufacture highly optimized components. However, these components require an understanding of relationships between the microstructure and mesostructure of the materials from which they are built, and the performance in terms of fatigue. Many microstructure-property relationships focus on the relationship between the microstructure and the quasi-static mechanical properties. However, accurate physical models that relate the fatigue properties to the microstrucuture and mesostructure of materials such as metallic AM alloys are lacking. The current study focuses on the effect of the microstrucuture and mesostructure of additively manufactured materials on fatigue properties. In particular, a fracture-mechanics-informed phenomenological model is introduced that accurately describes the influence of the initial discontinuity size, the applied maximum cyclic stress, and the ultimate tensile strength on the high cycle fatigue life of AlSi10Mg and Ti-6Al-4V made by laser powder bed fusion. The effect of the mesostructure on load re-distribution and crack re-nucleation during fatigue loading was investigated using stretch-dominated multiple load path specimens of AlSi10Mg and Ti-6Al-4V that were tested in the as-built surface condition. The results show that the multiple load path structures are more damage tolerant, but have an overall lower fatigue life.
papers.venue: NATO Journal of Science and Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文直接研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，建立了微观/介观结构与疲劳寿命的关系，特别关注了表面粗糙度和初始缺陷的影响。
llm.why_not_core: Although the paper focuses on Ti-6Al-4V fatigue, it also includes AlSi10Mg as a second material, and the primary model is not exclusively Ti-6Al-4V specific; however, it still contains substantial Ti-6Al-4V content.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造金属的疲劳性能与微观/介观结构的关系尚不明确。
summary_zh.method: 引入基于断裂力学的唯象模型，结合多路径试样实验研究介观结构影响。
summary_zh.result: 多路径结构损伤容限高但整体疲劳寿命降低，模型准确描述了初始缺陷、应力和强度的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过AlSi10Mg和Ti-6Al-4V的LPBF试样疲劳实验验证模型。

summary_en.motivation: The relationship between fatigue life and micro/mesostructure in additively manufactured metallic materials is poorly understood.
summary_en.method: A fracture-mechanics-informed phenomenological model was developed and validated using as-built fatigue tests on AlSi10Mg and Ti-6Al-4V specimens, including multiple load path designs.
summary_en.result: Multiple load path structures exhibited higher damage tolerance but lower overall fatigue life; the model accurately captured the effects of initial discontinuity size, applied stress, and ultimate tensile strength.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing of laser powder bed fusion AlSi10Mg and Ti-6Al-4V in as-built surface condition.

papers.title: Selective Laser Melting of a Ti-6Al-4V Lattice-Structure Gear: Design, Topology Optimization, and Experimental Validation
papers.abstract: The manufacture of lightweight components is one of the most important requirements in the automotive and aerospace industries. Gears, on the other hand, are among the heaviest parts in terms of their total weight. Accordingly, a spur gear was considered, the body of which was configured as a lattice structure to make it lightweight. In addition, the structure was optimized by topology optimization using ProTOP software. Subsequently, the gear was manufactured by a selective laser melting process by using a strong and lightweight material, namely Ti-6Al-4V. This study defeated the problems of manufacturing orientation, surface roughness, support structure, and bending due to the high thermal gradient in the selective laser melting process. To experimentally investigate the benefits of such a lightweight gear body structure, a new test rig with a closed loop was developed. This rig enabled measurements of strains in the gear ring, hub, and tooth root. The experimental results confirmed that a specifically designed and selectively laser-melted, lightweight cellular lattice structure in the gear body can significantly influence strain. This is especially significant with respect to strain levels and their time-dependent variations in the hub section of the gear body.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-6Al-4V点阵结构齿轮，与股骨柄植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: While the paper uses Ti-6Al-4V and laser powder bed fusion, it focuses on a gear for automotive/aerospace and does not address femoral stem design, implant mechanics, or orthopaedic applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 在汽车和航空航天领域实现齿轮轻量化。
summary_zh.method: 采用拓扑优化设计点阵结构齿轮，并通过选区激光熔化制造。
summary_zh.result: 实验验证了点阵结构可显著改变齿轮体的应变分布。
summary_zh.validation: 搭建闭环试验台测量齿圈、轮毂和齿根的应变。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve lightweight gears for automotive and aerospace applications by replacing solid gear bodies with lattice structures.
summary_en.method: A spur gear body was designed as a lattice structure and optimized via topology optimization using ProTOP software, then manufactured by selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: Experimental strain measurements on the gear ring, hub, and tooth root confirmed that the lattice structure significantly influences strain levels and time-dependent variations.
summary_en.validation: A custom closed-loop test rig was developed and used to measure strains in the gear body under load.
